operations.name: list_project_records
operations.description: List visible projects with configuration. Reuse an existing matching project before creation.

operations.name: create_project
operations.description: Create a project. name required; search_roots and instruction optional. Creation is not idempotent: list projects after an uncertain response.

operations.name: get_project
operations.description: Read a project.

operations.name: update_project
operations.description: Update only supplied name, search_roots, instruction fields.

operations.name: delete_project
operations.description: Delete project metadata and saved artifacts. Back up first. Does not delete external source directories.

operations.name: list_repositories
operations.description: List registered repositories and IDs.

operations.name: add_repository
operations.description: Register an explicit local path or Git URL. Fields: name, path, kind (service_repo/infra_repo), source_type (local/git), git_url, default_branch, team, pack_ids, instruction.

operations.name: get_repository
operations.description: Read repository configuration.

operations.name: update_repository
operations.description: Update supplied fields supported by add_repository; preserve unrelated values.

operations.name: delete_repository
operations.description: Remove registration, not source repository contents.

operations.name: import_repositories
operations.description: Preview/import local or GitHub repositories. provider local requires root; github requires org, optional api_base. Supports include/exclude regex, limit, recursive/max_depth, clone, clone_transport (auto/https/ssh), default_branch, include_forks/include_archived, team, concurrency. Use dry_run=true first; no credential arguments (credentials come from server environment). For full import+analysis prefer start_ingestion after preview.

operations.name: repository_suggestions
operations.description: Discover candidates under project search_roots. Requires host-discovery authority.

operations.name: sync_repository
operations.description: Sync a managed Git checkout. Local imports are not pulled. Inspect live status afterward.

operations.name: analyze_repository
operations.description: Start analysis of one repository; options are DiffMindRunOptions. Prefer start_ingestion for complete graph workflow.

operations.name: analyze_repositories
operations.description: Start a repository analysis batch. Prefer start_ingestion for analysis plus graph.

operations.name: get_repository_configuration
operations.description: Read effective editable YAML configuration.

operations.name: set_repository_configuration
operations.description: Validate/write repository analysis configuration; body is YAML text under the body field.

operations.name: get_workspace
operations.description: Workspace graph/configuration overview; may be large, prefer focused operations.

operations.name: get_live_status
operations.description: Current sync and analysis status.

operations.name: get_endpoint_contracts
operations.description: Get recorded request fields. Query: run and optional service. Empty results mean unsupported or absent evidence, not an empty runtime contract.

operations.name: compare_endpoint_contracts
operations.description: Compare request contracts between immutable runs. Query: from, to, optional service. Renames remain remove plus add without explicit alias evidence.

operations.name: list_improvement_gaps
operations.description: List persistent, revisioned extraction or graph gaps and their review history.

operations.name: record_improvement_gap
operations.description: Record a concrete expected-versus-observed gap. Read first and supply revision. New records always start observed; source_pointers must identify evidence without embedding private source.

operations.name: transition_improvement_gap
operations.description: Advance a gap through observed, reproduced, proposed, tested, accepted, active, and rolled_back. Rejected/deferred/superseded require a reason. Supply the latest collection revision; activation is a review state and does not itself mutate packs.

operations.name: start_ingestion
operations.description: Durable full workflow. Empty body incrementally syncs/analyzes/builds existing repos. import uses import_repositories fields (dry_run must be false). Options: concurrency 0..16, force boolean, options. Returns 202 before completion: poll get_ingestion. Never infer completion from acceptance.

operations.name: get_ingestion
operations.description: Poll latest ingestion. completed means done; partial/failed/cancelled require inspection. Includes phase, counts, errors, graph_run_id and repository progress.

operations.name: cancel_ingestion
operations.description: Request cancellation; poll until work drains.

operations.name: resume_ingestion
operations.description: Resume failed/interrupted/cancelled direct ingestion. Queued refreshes must use retry_job.

operations.name: list_jobs
operations.description: List durable jobs. Query: project, status, offset, limit.

operations.name: enqueue_refresh
operations.description: Queue a refresh respecting concurrency and project/global quotas.

operations.name: cancel_job
operations.description: Cancel a queued/running refresh; inspect job status afterward.

operations.name: retry_job
operations.description: Retry a failed/cancelled refresh while retaining attempt history.

operations.name: ingestion_history
operations.description: Read saved ingestion attempts. Query: offset, limit.

operations.name: get_session
operations.description: Authenticated identity, role and project-access mode.

operations.name: get_capabilities
operations.description: Effective caller permissions for this project.

operations.name: get_access
operations.description: Read project membership revision and grants. Administrator only.

operations.name: set_access
operations.description: Replace memberships using the current revision; read first, preserve other members. Administrator only.

operations.name: get_limits
operations.description: Read quota policy, revision and effective usage.

operations.name: set_limits
operations.description: Administrator sets pending-job and repository worker caps with current revision. 0 inherits global budgets.

operations.name: list_tokens
operations.description: Administrator lists project token metadata (never secrets).

operations.name: issue_token
operations.description: Administrator issues scoped viewer/editor token. Secret returned ONCE: keep out of chat/logs. Not idempotent; do not blindly retry. Lifetime 60..31536000 seconds; scoped mode required.

operations.name: revoke_token
operations.description: Administrator permanently revokes this token.

operations.name: refresh_status
operations.description: Fleet schedule and refresh progress.

operations.name: refresh_all
operations.description: Administrator queues fleet refresh.

operations.name: list_project_packs
operations.description: List project-scoped declarative packs.

operations.name: get_project_pack
operations.description: Read pack JSON before editing. pack_id is the storage key returned by create/list, which can differ from the manifest id.

operations.name: create_project_pack
operations.description: Create a validated project pack. Body is the complete KnowledgePack JSON manifest, not a wrapper. Include synthetic tests. Use local agent_command pack tools for scaffolding/fixtures/installing global packs.

operations.name: update_project_pack
operations.description: Validate/replace complete pack JSON. Preserve the existing manifest id; use the create/list storage key as pack_id. Read existing pack first; update graph afterward.

operations.name: delete_project_pack
operations.description: Remove a project pack; historical graphs are unchanged.

operations.name: list_analysis_runs
operations.description: Discover analysis artifacts. Optional query repo_path.

operations.name: list_run_records
operations.description: List graph runs including incomplete/failed runs.

operations.name: create_graph_run
operations.description: Build from explicit existing analysis references. Prefer start_ingestion for automatic selection.

operations.name: get_run
operations.description: Read graph run and active state.

operations.name: cancel_run
operations.description: Cancel graph build.

operations.name: delete_run
operations.description: Delete saved graph run/artifacts; irreversible without backup.

operations.name: list_pull_requests
operations.description: List provider pull requests, using server credentials.

operations.name: pull_request_impact
operations.description: Inspect pull request impact.

workflow: list projects before creating; do not retry creation blindly after a lost response
start_ingestion with import or {} for incremental refresh
get_ingestion until completed; inspect failures before retry
query graph and verify source evidence

data.lifecycle: Agent-owned: starts on connection/management, stops on disconnect. Use shared deployment for always-on refresh.
